name: Hirusagari no Boro Apart to Hitozuma-tachi ~Heisa Kuukan de Kurui Ochiteiku~
original_name: 昼下がりのボロアパートと人妻たち 〜閉鎖空間で狂い堕ちていく〜
source:
It is the early years of the Heisei era, and Takumi Nakama is the caretaker of a rundown apartment building. He has nothing to do and has failed the university entrance exam, so his parents provide him with an apartment where he can live and work.

There were two young wives in the apartment that his parents had provided for him to live and work: Akemi Ushio, a tall and active woman who was cheerful and open-minded, and Shino Kumagaya, a refined and fastidious young lady who had grown up in a well off family.

Takumi is teased, scorned, and played with by these beautiful but married women. However, confined in a closed space, these women gradually break down due to their own problems and conflicts.

translation:
平成初期，仲间匠是一栋破旧公寓楼的管理员。他无事可做，高考也未及格，所以他的父母为他提供了一套公寓，让他可以生活和工作。

父母为他提供生活和工作的公寓里有两个年轻的妻子：牛尾明美，一个身材高大、活泼、开朗、开朗的女人；熊谷诗乃，一个精致、挑剔、生长在富裕家庭的年轻女士。

拓海被这些美丽但已婚的女人嘲笑、蔑视和玩弄。然而，在封闭的空间里，这些女性却因为自身的问题和矛盾而逐渐崩溃。
